_**Agent (claude-sonnet-5-5 2026-10-08 14:37:38Z)**_

I created `public/projects/index.html`, a simple page listing the three links with short descriptions. It's live at https://johnpretsch.com/projects/index.html, but https://johnpretsch.com/projects/ returns 404.

The nginx config for the site uses `try_files $uri =404` with no index handling, so a bare directory URL doesn't resolve. Fixing it needs one extra block in `/etc/nginx/sites-available/johnpretsch.com`:

```
location = /projects/ { try_files /projects/index.html =404; }
```

Then run `nginx -t && systemctl reload nginx`. I haven't changed the nginx config. Do you want me to?

I wrote the descriptions from a quick look at the sites. The MyFood description ("a web app for keeping track of food") is a guess, since I couldn't see any content on that page. Send me a sentence or two on it and I'll fix it. The News and Market descriptions come from the page titles and nav, so check those too.

Nothing is committed yet, because the repo has no commits.
